name: negative-ssh-session
description: Legitimate interactive SSH session, NOT a reverse shell. A login shell (bash, argv[0]='-bash') is exec'd and its connection is to the SSH port (22), not a reverse-shell callback port. The sequence's socket-connect step matches only configured callback ports (4444 etc.), so port 22 leaves the sequence incomplete (no alert). Defense-in-depth: the SSH admin-port exception (dst_port in [22,2222]) and the interactive login-shell exception (argv contains '-bash') would also suppress. Expect no match.
